aboutText: Shaun's Plumbing in Deer Park is an accredited and fully insured business, holding all necessary licences and equipment to handle any plumbing need. We proudly service all of Melbourne, with no job considered too small, and approach every task with a can-do attitude. Our extensive experience spans domestic plumbing, including roofing and gutters, new fit-outs, leak repairs, and hot water service and replacements. As locals, we understand the importance of reliable plumbing for Deer Park homes and businesses.
servicesText: From routine maintenance to emergency repairs, we provide a full range of plumbing services in Deer Park. Our team is equipped to handle everything from leak detection to hot water system installations, ensuring your plumbing is always in top condition.
